<!-- pr-reviewer: 52457c32fb48c2987a55fa1eae8da5ef09ae7dfc -->
**Needs changes before merge.** Reviewed while still a draft, as the maintainer asked, on the cheap tier: docs/process only, so no build and no tests. The PR stays a draft.

**What looks good**
- `PROCESS_VERSION` 13 -> 14 is exactly main's 13 + 1. `Changelog: none` is set, and the body has the "For forks" instruction.
- The 4 h rule for the owner account's agents is unchanged. The `P?` rule, the "held by a fresh agent claim" case and the "label set by hand: leave it" case are still there.
- AGENTS.md and the skill use the same stale-release wording and the same withdrawn wording.
- Both shell commands are well-formed (checked read-only, see the report in the review run).

**Requested before merge**
1. `.claude/skills/review-prs/SKILL.md`, step 4 "Add", bullet "held by someone else": it still blocks on "an earlier claim comment by another contributor still exists", with no liveness test. A stale contributor claim therefore still locks the issue for the next contributor, which is the stall this PR is meant to end. Fix: the holder must be a LIVE claim (not stale, not ended). Make the same change in AGENTS.md "Check before claiming" (the "unless ... stale" wording there is right, but "Mirror it" should say the same).
2. AGENTS.md "Withdrawn or released" and SKILL.md step 4 "stale or ended": once a stale claim is released with the agent comment `claim by @<login> released (stale ...)`, the old claim comment still exists. If the claimant then posts anything within 48 h, the liveness test says live again and the Add pass mirrors the old comment. The stale-release comment must also END the claim, and "an ended claim is never mirrored back" must cover it, not only "released by the maintainer". Add it to both lists.
3. AGENTS.md lines 206-210 ("Claim before any code"): "Never work an issue that carries `claimed` unless its last claim comment is an agent's ..." has no exception for a contributor claim that is stale or ended. Add "or a contributor's claim that is stale or ended (A claim comment is a claim, below)", and drop the paraphrase "after 48 hours with nothing behind it" in favour of the pointer, so the test is stated once.
4. AGENTS.md lines 267-271: the heading's quote "Otherwise the comment stands as claimed." is superseded by the new sub-points. Mark it, e.g. "(superseded in part on 2026-11-11, see below)", so a cheap reader does not apply the old quote.
5. `P?` issues: the stale-release step in SKILL.md "Withdraw" (and the AGENTS "Maintenance" sweep) removes `claimed` from any issue with a stale claim, including `P?` issues. The `P?` rule says agents change no labels on a `P?` issue. Add "skip `P?` issues (AGENTS, `P?` is paused)" to the stale branch of both.
6. SKILL.md step 4 "Add", bullet "withdrawn" still names only `unclaim` / `/unclaim`. It is harmless because the "stale or ended" bullet comes after it, but make the two lists identical or point the reader to AGENTS "Withdrawn or released".
7. AGENTS.md "Mirror it": the sentence breaks mid-phrase ("but without the" / "label gets ..."). Reflow it. Indentation of the new sub-points matches the surrounding bullets.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- "an open PR for the issue" does not say whose PR. A third party's open PR for the issue keeps a stale claim live under the literal text. The skill's `gh pr list --search "<N> in:title,body"` does not filter by author either. Say "by the claimant" if that is the intent.
- The Add pass reads only comments from the last 7 days. A claim whose comment is older than 7 days, with a fresh commit on its branch, is never mirrored. Probably intended; say so.
- The fork liveness command needs `<owner>` = the claimant's login (the fork is still named Camcraft). The skill does not say that, nor what to do on an error (a branch that is not in that fork means no commit). One line would settle it.
- The stale-release comment has a literal `@<login>`, which pings the claimant once the login is filled in. Fine if intended.

**Walk-through of the cases (what the text gives)**
- (a) claimed 3 days ago, open draft PR for the issue, no comment since: **live** (open PR). Decided, except for whose PR (note above).
- (b) claimed 3 days ago, no PR, branch commit 5 days ago, progress comment 30 h ago: **live** (comment within 48 h). Decided.
- (c) research claim 50 h ago, no later comment: **stale**. Decided; no branch, so only the comment could keep it live.
- (d) claimed 10 h ago, nothing else: **live** (the claim comment is itself a claimant comment within 48 h). Decided.
- (e) last comment "Releasing this claim": **ended**. Listed as a withdrawal phrase in AGENTS and the skill. Decided for that exact phrase; a paraphrase ("I'm dropping this") is not listed, so a cheap reader may miss it.
- (f) "released by the maintainer" comment, old claim comment still there: **never mirrored**. Decided. The exact wording of the maintainer's comment is not fixed; see request 2 for the agent's stale-release comment.
- (g) after (f), a new `claimed:` comment: **live again**. Decided: a new claim line is a new claim, and it is within 48 h.
- (h) claimant commented yesterday, only to answer an unrelated question: **live**, by the literal text ("any comment by the claimant ... in the last 48 hours"). This is a loophole: an idle claimant can hold an issue with chatter. It is consistent and simple, so acceptable if the maintainer wants it; if the loophole is to be closed, require a progress, finding or PR comment. Maintainer's call, not a blocker.

**Questions**
- Is the stale-release comment meant to ping the claimant (see note above)?

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 944ebe3a0e324a39d951571d2d80172b83fedd96 -->
**Needs changes before merge (delta re-check of 944ebe3a).** Reviewed while still a draft, as the maintainer asked, on the cheap tier. Docs/process only: no build, no tests. The PR stays a draft.

**Delta checked:** `git diff 52457c32 944ebe3a` touches `AGENTS.md` and `.claude/skills/review-prs/SKILL.md`. `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` is 14 and main (a124496c) is still 13, so 14 is main + 1 and is still the right number. Mergeable: MERGEABLE, mergeStateStatus CLEAN. No conflict markers. The `gh pr list --state open --author "mkinney" --search "866 in:title,body" --json number,headRefName` shape runs (returns `[]`).

**Earlier findings**
1. Held only by a LIVE claim (SKILL step 4 "held by someone else", AGENTS "Mirror it"): **resolved.**
2. Stale-release comment ends the claim (AGENTS "Withdrawn or released", SKILL "ended" bullet, Add pass "whatever the claimant comments afterwards"): **resolved.**
3. AGENTS "Claim before any code" exception for contributor claims: **resolved, with a new wording problem (see 1 below).** The 48-hour paraphrase is still there beside the pointer; it no longer contradicts, but the test is not stated only once.
4. Superseded marker on the 2026-11-08 quote: **resolved**, user's words kept.
5. `P?` never relabelled by an agent, stale or not (AGENTS "live" bullet; SKILL Withdraw pass): **resolved**, but the rule sits in the liveness bullet, not in "Withdrawn or released". Not blocking.
6. SKILL "ended" wording matches AGENTS: **resolved.**
7. "Mirror it" reflowed; four-space continuations under `  - ` bullets are consistent: **resolved.**
Notes from the last review: whose PR counts (now "by the claimant"): resolved. Fork commit lookup by claimant's login, error means no commit: resolved. "Any comment counts" is stated as deliberate: resolved. Still open and not blocking: the 7-day window in the Add pass, and the literal `@<login>` in the stale-release comment.

**Requested before merge**
1. AGENTS.md "Claim before any code", the "Two:" exception (around lines 206-210): it says a withdrawn, released or stale contributor claim is released "and the issue is free". That conflicts with "A `P?` issue is never relabelled by an agent" (AGENTS, "A claim must be live"). Add "(not on a `P?` issue - report it instead)" to "Two", so the two rules agree.
2. Stale claim next to a fresh claim (case (i) below) is not decided. Pick one rule and write it in AGENTS "Mirror it" and SKILL step 4 "held by someone else": e.g. when a contributor's new claim is mirrored over an older stale claim by someone else, the old claim is ended with a comment `claim by @<login> released (superseded by @<login2>) - issue is free again`, so it cannot be revived by a later comment. Without that, a later Withdraw pass may read A's stale comment as "the claim behind the label" and remove B's label.
3. Precedence of "ended" over "live" is implied, not stated. The liveness test counts "any comment of theirs" in the last 48 hours, so a withdrawal comment like "Releasing this claim" is itself a claimant comment inside 48 h. Add one sentence to AGENTS "A claim must be live": "A claim that has ended (see Withdrawn or released) is not revived by the liveness test; the withdrawal comment itself does not count as activity."
4. AGENTS "Claim before any code", "Two:": the 48-hour paraphrase. Replace it with the pointer only ("...is withdrawn, released or stale - see A claim must be live and Withdrawn or released below").

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
- Case (j), stale claim on a `P?` issue: the Add pass lists the `P?` bullet before the stale bullet, so the "paused" reply is posted even for a stale claim. Say whether the reply is wanted for a stale claim, or whether liveness is checked first.
- Case (g): "released by the maintainer" in the ended bullet does not say the release must come after the claim. Say "after its claim comment" as the Withdraw pass does.
- The stale-release comment template still has a literal `@<login>`, which pings the claimant. Fine if intended.

**Walk-through of (a)-(j) against the new text**
- (a) claimed 3 days ago, open draft PR by the claimant for the issue, no comment since: **LIVE** (an open PR by the claimant counts, drafts included). Decided.
- (b) claimed 3 days ago, no PR, branch commit 5 days ago, progress comment 30 h ago: **LIVE** (comment within 48 h). Decided.
- (c) research claim 50 h ago, no later comment: **STALE**, skipped; the Withdraw pass releases it with the stale comment if labelled. Decided.
- (d) claimed 10 h ago, nothing else: **LIVE.** Decided.
- (e) last comment "Releasing this claim": **ENDED** (listed phrase). Decided for that exact wording; a paraphrase ("I'm dropping this") is not listed. Ended-beats-live is implied only (request 3).
- (f) "released by the maintainer" after the claim comment: **ENDED**, never mirrored. Decided.
- (g) after (f), a new `claimed:` line: **LIVE** again, mirrored. Decided by the "only a NEW claim line" sentence; the release-before-claim order is not spelled out (note above).
- (h) agent's stale release yesterday, claimant commented today without a new claim line: **STILL ENDED.** Decided: "whatever the claimant comments afterwards".
- (i) B claims an issue where A's 5-day-old claim has nothing behind it: A's claim is **STALE, not ENDED** (no stale-release comment is posted when nothing is labelled). B is mirrored and takes it. **Not decided:** A's claim is not released; if A comments again within 48 h it is live again and nothing says who keeps the issue; and the Withdraw pass cannot tell which claim comment is "the claim behind the label" (request 2).
- (j) stale claim on a `P?` issue: **no relabel**, reported to the maintainer. Decided, except for the reply question (note above).

**Other checks:** no new typos or broken list nesting found; the 4-space continuations are consistent. `CHANGELOG`/`Changelog: none` and the `Fixes`/body rules are unchanged.

**Label:** `needs-rework` stays until items 1-2 are settled (3-4 are small text fixes).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: f5914d66271cdc7614f1d8f34f155fd6f26cb038 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (third delta check, on the cheap review tier at the maintainer's instruction; the PR is still a draft, so the draft flag is the maintainer's call).

Delta reviewed: `944ebe3a..f5914d66`, one commit, touching `AGENTS.md` and `.claude/skills/review-prs/SKILL.md` only. Process/docs only: no build, no tests, no worktree.

**What looks good**
- Exception Two (AGENTS.md:210-213) now says "Never on a `P?` issue: no agent relabels or works one", so it no longer contradicts the `P?` rule.
- The `P?` paused bullet in the skill runs before the held bullet, so a claim on a `P?` issue never reaches the release step.
- Ended beats live is stated in both files: AGENTS.md:310-311 ("Ended beats live ... an ended claim is never live again") and the skill's stale bullet ("a comment that withdraws or releases the claim is not activity: ended beats live").
- Exception Two points at "A claim comment is a claim" and no longer repeats the 48-hour paraphrase.
- PROCESS_VERSION: head is 14, `origin/main` is 13 (`a124496c`), so the bump is exactly +1.
- The PR is MERGEABLE and CLEAN.
- Indentation of the changed bullets matches their neighbours (AGENTS.md 2-space bullets with 4-space continuation; the skill's bullets use 2-space continuation).

**Results on the four points**
1. Exception Two excludes `P?` issues: **resolved** (AGENTS.md:213).
2. Case (i) is decided in both files, and they agree: **resolved**. Walk-through for an agent processing contributor B's claim on an issue where contributor A's days-old claim sits with nothing behind it:
   1. B's claim is not ended and the issue is not `P?`, so the paused and ended bullets pass.
   2. The skill's "held by someone else" bullet finds A's claim is not live, so it does not hold the issue.
   3. The liveness test (no open PR, no branch commit and no comment by A in 48 h) shows A's claim is stale and not yet released. The agent posts A's stale-release comment and removes A's assignment (and label, if present). That comment ends A's claim, so A commenting later does not revive it.
   4. B's own liveness passes (the claim comment is B's own recent comment), so the agent runs `gh issue edit N --add-label claimed --add-assignee B` and replies "Claim recorded for @B".
   5. Later, the Withdraw pass sees the label on B, finds B's claim comment intact, and keeps it.
   Both AGENTS.md "Mirror it" (lines 287-292) and the skill's "held by someone else" bullet say this.
3. Ended beats live: **resolved** in both files, as above.
4. Exception Two cross-references the rule without the 48-hour paraphrase: **resolved**.

**Nothing new that blocks.** Non-blocking notes:
- Skill "held by someone else": "post the stale-release comment from the Withdraw pass" is loose. The Withdraw pass only scans issues that carry `claimed`, so for a comment-only stale claim (no label) the release comment is posted from the held bullet itself. Consider "post the stale-release comment (template in the Withdraw pass)".
- AGENTS.md "Mirror it" says to release the stale claim first but does not say to remove that claimant's assignment; the skill does. Adding "and the assignment" would make the two files match word for word.
- Skill stale bullet has a ragged wrap ("Check" alone at a line end, then "liveness with"). Cosmetic.
- AGENTS.md "Check before claiming" (around line 282): the sentence "comment stands as claimed." still sits inside a quoted user message that now carries the "superseded" note. It reads fine, but a reader might take the superseded sentence for current rule text.

Requested before merge: nothing.

Questions / notes: none that block. A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
